description: Reply to an existing comment, creating a threaded response under it. Optionally assign the reply and notify watchers. Returns the created reply's id.

assignee.description: User ID to assign this reply to.

comment_id.description: ID of the parent comment to reply to.

comment_text.description: The reply body text (plain text or ClickUp markdown).

notify_all.description: If true, notify everyone with access; otherwise only the assignee is notified.

name: create_threaded_comment
